brief: The content loop that grew my X account to 50K in 90 days — 6 tactical moves.

slots.title: Post Every Single Day
slots.body: Consistency beats talent when talent doesn't show up. I published twice daily for 90 days straight, even when no one engaged. The algorithm rewards volume and velocity above perfection.

slots.title: Reply to Big Accounts Fast
slots.body: I set alerts for 20 creators in my niche and replied with genuine insights within 15 minutes. This put my profile in front of thousands of targeted readers daily.
slots.takeaway: Speed and value in replies brings free exposure.

slots.title: Turn One Idea Into Ten
slots.body: Every thread became a tweet, a carousel, and a quote graphic. Repurposing isn't lazy; it's smart leverage that multiplies your reach without burning out.
slots.takeaway: One great idea deserves ten lives.

slots.title: Build a Hook Swipe File
slots.body: I saved the top 50 viral posts in my niche and studied their openers. Great hooks stop the scroll. I templated them and filled in my own stories.
slots.takeaway: Swipe files turn guesswork into science.

slots.title: Study Your Analytics Weekly
slots.body: Every Sunday I checked which posts won and why. I stripped away topics that flopped and doubled down on the angles that sparked real engagement.
slots.takeaway: Let data drive your content calendar.

slots.title: Turn Followers Into Friends
slots.body: I sent 20 personalized DMs daily and started a free newsletter. Building a tight community creates advocates who share your content without being asked.
Pick one tactic and execute it tomorrow morning. Momentum starts with a single post.
